messages.content:
A photon checks into a hotel. The bellhop asks, "Can I help you with your luggage?"

The photon replies, "No thanks, I'm traveling light."

---

I like this one because it's pleasantly groan-worthy - the kind of pun that makes you both laugh and roll your eyes. Physics jokes have this nice quality where the setup sounds completely normal until the punchline recontextualizes everything.
